finalText:
**Plan: add `--json` to the `report` command.**

The data splits two ways. `buildRows()` in [report.js:11](src/report.js:11) yields six fields. `toTable` in [format.js:7](src/format.js:7) prints only four. It drops `owner` and `slow` for width reasons.

So "same data" is ambiguous. I'd emit the full `buildRows()` row, all six fields. That matches the note in `format.js` saying whole-row consumers go to `buildRows`, not the table.

Steps:
1. Add `toJson(rows)` to `format.js`, `JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2)`.
2. In [cli.js:14](src/cli.js:14), branch on `argv.includes('--json')`.
3. Update `USAGE` to `report [--json]`.
4. Reject unknown flags so typos fail loud.

Say the word and I build it. Tell me if you want four fields instead.
